header: **Status:** CITED (literature — O'Sullivan, arXiv:2007.13582v2; statement recorded in the source's words, not quoted verbatim)
**Source:** [`xi-horn/uniformity-in-the-jensen-degree-d.md`](../xi-horn/uniformity-in-the-jensen-degree-d.md) — §5 "The criterion is the free parameter — and what it cannot buy"

> Here g*_d(Ω; x) is the reciprocal Jensen polynomial of Ω, and Lemma 3.4 identifies (3.5) as g*_d(Φ·Ω; x): **every choice of Ω is the classical Jensen family of the product Φ·Ω**, and multiplying by an LP factor neither adds nor removes real-zero content.
- (3.5) is the family of [O'S] Theorem 3.5: Σ_{j=0}^{d} C(d,j) · c_j · g*_{d−j}(Ω; x), for Φ(z) = Σ_{j≥0} c_j·z^j/j! real entire of genus 1\* and Ω in the Laguerre–Pólya class.
